class.name: NetwPredictionHandle
class.brief_description: Prediction settings and diagnostics for one [NetwEntity].
class.description: Reached by [member NetwEntity.prediction]. The client predicts its entity ahead of the server and corrects it when the server's state disagrees. This handle sets how that happens. [codeblock] var pred := NetwEntity.of(self).prediction pred.archetype = NetwPredict.ARCHETYPE_SOLVER_BODY pred.witness_contacts = _sample_contacts pred.breach_response = NetwPredict.BREACH_RESPONSE_DEMOTE [/codeblock] Only an entity with a [method NetwPropertyConfig.state] property is predicted, because that state is what gets compared and restored. Per-field tolerances are set with [NetwPropertyConfig]. The schedule and the simulation mode are on [member NetwEntity.simulation]. Values set on a [MultiplayerSynchronizer] in the scene act as defaults, and values set in code override them.

method.name: bind_entity
method.description: Binds the entity this handle belongs to. Called by Networked when it creates the handle.

method.name: entity
method.description: The entity this handle belongs to, or [code]null[/code] once that entity is gone.

method.name: is_registered
method.description: Whether the entity is being predicted, as opposed to only configured.

method.name: notify_contact
method.description: Holds off small corrections for [member collision_cooldown_ticks]. Call it on the controlling client when the predicted body collides, so the correction does not fight the collision.

method.name: reachability
method.description:
Reports, field by field, whether this entity's prediction settings take effect. Returns an empty [Dictionary] before the entity is predicted. Use it while wiring an entity to find settings that are accepted but do nothing. [codeblock] var report := entity.prediction.reachability() for key: StringName in report[&"fields"]: var row: Dictionary = report[&"fields"][key] var model: Dictionary = row[&"forward_model"] if not model[&"live"] and model[&"kind"] != &"none": print(key, " forward model is not live, ", model[&"why"])
print(report[&"breach"]) print(report[&"findings"]) [/codeblock] [code]fields[/code] is keyed by property, and each row carries the following. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴class which NetwPropertySet.PropertyClass it is ┠╴triggers whether it can force a correction on its own ┠╴tolerance the epsilon in force, and who declared it ┠╴teleport_at the teleport distance, and who declared it ┠╴in_tier whether it is in the tier being compared ┠╴operators what may write it during a recovery ┖╴forward_model {kind, live, why} [/codeblock] [code]findings[/code] lists the same warnings printed when the entity is set up.

method.name: resolved_recovery_policy
method.description: The [enum NetwPredict.RecoveryPolicy] this entity actually uses. [constant NetwPredict.RECOVERY_POLICY_AUTO] is resolved from the body, and a physics body at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_FRAME] resolves [constant NetwPredict.RECOVERY_POLICY_REBASE_REPLAY] to [constant NetwPredict.RECOVERY_POLICY_REBASE_RECOVER].

method.name: sensor
simulate_frame
method.description: Steps an entity at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_FRAME] once, as the session would. Does nothing for an entity at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_TICK] or one that is not predicted.

method.name: simulate_tick
method.description: Steps the entity for [param tick]. Does nothing for an entity that is not predicted.

members.member: How many ticks the last input the server acknowledged is behind the newest input. On a healthy connection it stays near zero, and a growing value means the server is falling behind. [member NetwSimulationHandle.max_restore_ticks] caps it on the client.
A preset for this entity's prediction settings and [member NetwSimulationHandle.schedule]. Settings written afterwards override the preset. No preset sets [member breach_response].
What this entity does when it touches a moving body this peer does not simulate. It only takes effect once [member witness_contacts] is set.
How many ticks [method notify_contact] holds off corrections. An error past [member teleport_threshold] still corrects.

How many ticks of input the server keeps queued before running them. A small buffer absorbs jitter so the entity steps every tick, and each tick of buffer adds a tick of input latency. [code]0[/code] runs inputs as they arrive.
How far the predicted state may drift from the server's before it is corrected. [method NetwPropertyConfig.epsilon] overrides it for one field.
The version of the static world this entity simulates against, or [code]-1[/code] when unset. Raise it when the level changes, so the next mispredictions are tolerated while peers catch up.

How far the server may fall behind the newest input before it skips ahead to it. Without this, a client that joins a running session can leave the server behind for good. [code]0[/code] disables skipping.

How many queued inputs the server may skip in one frame to catch up, for an entity at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_FRAME]. An entity at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_TICK] ignores it.
What the server does when an input never arrives.
Whether this entity is corrected alone or together with the entities its [member NetwEntity.simulation] selects.
How this entity is corrected. [method resolved_recovery_policy] returns the policy in use.

How many inputs the server keeps queued before running them, for an entity at [constant NetwSimulationHandle.SCHEDULE_FRAME]. Each one adds a tick of latency, so leave it at [code]0[/code] unless you need it.
Callables that sample the world this entity reads, by name. Each is called once before each step, and [method sensor] reads the sample back. A misprediction can then be blamed on the world.
Set it while the server's body is asleep. Corrections pause, so they do not wake it.
This entity's prediction counters.

How large an error may be before a correction teleports the body, restoring every field including [method NetwPropertyConfig.teleport_only] ones. It applies to fields declared with [method NetwPropertyConfig.carry_along], and [method NetwPropertyConfig.teleport_at] overrides it per field. An entity with no such field teleports on every correction.

Returns whether the path to a proposed pose is clear, called as [code]corridor(current, proposed)[/code]. Set it to let a correction move the body straight to where it should be now, without going through a wall.
Returns the colliders this peer's body touched in the step just solved. Set it so a misprediction can be blamed on a contact and [member breach_response] can take effect.

signal.name: divergence_detected
episode_closed
signal.description: Emitted when the peers have agreed again for long enough, ending the episode [signal episode_opened] started. [param report] has the shape described in [signal episode_opened].

signal.name: episode_fallback
signal.description: Emitted when corrections stop helping and the entity starts following the server. It keeps sending input. [param report] has the shape described in [signal episode_opened].

signal.name: episode_opened
signal.description: Emitted when a misprediction is large enough to act on. The corrections that follow, until the peers agree again, are reported together as one episode. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴id int ┠╴generator Dictionary ┃ ┠╴transition int ┃ ┠╴boundary NetwPredict.Attribution ┃ ┖╴row Dictionary ┠╴operators Array[Dictionary] ┃ ┠╴operator NetwPredict.Operator ┃ ┠╴basis int ┃ ┠╴eligible bool ┃ ┠╴applied bool ┃ ┠╴eligibility Dictionary ┃ ┠╴outcome NetwPredict.OperatorOutcome ┃ ┖╴write Dictionary ┠╴contraction Array[Dictionary] ┃ ┖╴ transition, meter, agrees, write_id ┠╴disposition Dictionary ┃ ┠╴state NetwPredict.EpisodeState ┃ ┠╴non_contraction_used int ┃ ┠╴closure_used int ┃ ┠╴closed_transition int ┃ ┠╴fallback_transition int ┃ ┠╴demoted bool ┃ ┠╴breach_transition int ┃ ┠╴breach_witness Dictionary ┃ ┠╴resume_ack_age int ┃ ┠╴quarantine_target int ┃ ┠╴quarantine_clean_run int ┃ ┠╴reseed_transition int ┃ ┠╴aligned_transition int ┃ ┖╴evidence_dropped int ┖╴reopen_chain Array[int] [/codeblock] [code]generator[/code] is the tick where the peers first disagreed, or [constant GENERATOR_UNKNOWN_BEYOND_RETENTION] when it is too old to be kept. An operator that was rejected has [code]outcome = -1[/code] and an empty [code]write[/code]. Long series are trimmed to the newest entries, and [code]evidence_dropped[/code] counts what was trimmed.

signal.name: recovered
signal.description: Emitted after a correction moved the body. [param deltas] holds how far each field moved, as [code]after - before[/code], with angles taken the short way around. [param teleported] is [code]true[/code] when the correction was a teleport. Under [constant NetwMultiplayer.LIVE_MODE_CHASE] the display already smooths the correction away. [codeblock] entity.interpolation.live_mode = NetwMultiplayer.LIVE_MODE_CHASE api.display_set_param(entity.rid, NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_PARAM_CHASE_GLIDE_TIME, 0.15) [/codeblock]

signal.name: state_evaluated
signal.description: Emitted on the controlling client each time server state arrives. [param divergence] is the largest error of any field, including errors under [member divergence_epsilon]. [param diverged] is whether the error was large enough to act on, even when no correction was written. Connect to [signal recovered] to know when the body actually moved.

constants.constant: The tick where the peers first disagreed is older than the kept history.
